description: NaAsO₃ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with five AsO₄ tetrahedra, edges with four NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one AsO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.57 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with five AsO₄ tetrahedra, edges with four NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one AsO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.49 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six AsO₄ tetrahedra and edges with six NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.41 Å. There are three inequivalent As sites. In the first As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two AsO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-62°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.65-1.77 Å. In the second As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-67°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.65-1.77 Å. In the third As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-67°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.64-1.78 Å. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two As atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one As atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one As atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two As atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one As atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one As atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one As atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two As atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one As atom.
